Specification: This specification is a small test module for TLC model values. It declares three constants a, b, and c, one variable x, initializes x to 1, and defines only stuttering behavior by leaving x unchanged in Next. The main property-like operator Inv checks that the model value a is not treated as a string, not equal to the concrete set {1, 2}, not a member of a numeric set comprehension, and not a member of the explicitly enumerated set {b, c}; each check uses Assert on failure and Print on success.
IfThenElse: IF a \in STRING THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 failed") ELSE Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE)
IF a = {1, 2} THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 failed") ELSE Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE)
IF a \in {i \in Nat : i > 7} THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 failed") ELSE Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE)
IF a \in {b, c} THEN Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 failed") ELSE Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE)
